_readme: Copy to customer.config.json (git-ignored) to brand the lab. Branding and vocabulary only: name, tagline, vertical (airlines, retail, health or finance; airlines is the default) and the cast words the stories and the talk track use. Everything is plain text; anything else is ignored with a warning. Never put a real customer's name in a file that is committed.
